$comment: One entry of the `plugins` value: a plugin pinned to an immutable source, with the skills to enable from it. Referenced from values.yaml (`plugins: [] # @schema itemRef:plugin.schema.json`) and bundled into values.schema.json by the helm-schema pre-commit hook. The source rules mirror skill.schema.json and what the api.kagent.dev/v1alpha3 AgentTemplateSpec refuses at admission (plugins[].source), so a branch, a tag, a short SHA or an OCI tag fails `helm template` instead of the API server.

git.description: A git repository at a full commit id; exactly one of git and oci is set.

url.description: http(s) URL of the repository. A private repository needs `skillsGitAuthSecretRef` and an https URL.

commit.description: Full commit id, 40 or 64 hex characters. Branches, tags and short SHAs are refused.

oci.description: Digest-pinned image reference (`<ref>@sha256:<64 hex>`); a tag is refused. Exactly one of git and oci is set.

path.description: Directory of the bundle within the artifact: relative, no `..` segments.

skills.description: Names of the skills to enable from an Agent Plugins format package (`plugin.json` at its root), unique; omitted or empty enables none of its skills, while its `mcp.json` servers still load. A Claude Code format plugin (`.claude-plugin/plugin.json`) loads whole on the `claude` Harness (`--plugin-dir`: its skills, hooks, commands and subagents) and needs no selection; the Harness ignores one.
